battlefield.note: A steppe salient cut by wooded ravines, with the Olkhovatka heights in the north, the Psel river across the middle and the open field at Prokhorovka.

popup.title: Kursk: Operation Citadel
popup.body:
You command the Soviet fronts in the Kursk salient. German armour is coming at both shoulders at once: Model from Orel in the north and Hoth from Belgorod in the south. Let the defensive belts and their forts wear the Tigers down, keep your tank brigades back to plug breakthroughs, and hold Kursk and Oboyan.

Objective: Hold Kursk and Oboyan for 5:00.

Operation Citadel opened on 5 July 1943 with German attacks on the Kursk salient from north and south. The Soviet defences, prepared for months, held; at Prokhorovka on 12 July the 5th Guards Tank Army met the II SS Panzer Corps, and the offensive was called off.

popup.title: Model attacks in the north
popup.body: The Ninth Army is driving on Ponyri. Hold the northern belt.

popup.title: Hoth attacks in the south
popup.body: The SS panzer divisions are driving on Oboyan.

popup.title: The SS turn on Prokhorovka
popup.body: The II SS Panzer Corps is swinging east toward Prokhorovka.

popup.title: 5th Guards Tank Army
popup.body: The Steppe Front's tank army has arrived north of Prokhorovka. Throw it at the SS.

popup.title: Model's last push
popup.body: The Ninth Army makes a last attempt to break through to Kursk.
